name: Celestial Gear Meadow
description: A meadow where delicate brass gears sprout like flowers, turning slowly under a sky of drifting constellations.
prompt: A peaceful meadow at night. Instead of flowers, small brass gears emerge from the grass, each rotating slowly. Above, constellations drift lazily, their light reflecting off the polished gear teeth. Dreamy, detailed, 8k.
caption: Time grows like wildflowers here. ⚙️🌌
